D8Digital

Wavetable Oscillator

Digital oscillator with morphing

Plays stored waveforms. MORPH sweeps smoothly through the waves of a table, WT selects the table.

  • Pitch at 1 V/oct
  • MORPH is CV controllable
  • Several wavetables to choose from

Height3 U · 128.5 mm
